title: board.reach: a way people reach a teammate that a channel module offers, shown on the teammate's "How to reach" card. Compile adds `module`.

id.description: its address within the module; unique across modules

label.description: its row's name on the card (Own Slack app, Email)

kind.description: app: the agent's own app or bot (its entry reads Connected once the secret map holds its tokens); address: an email address people write to (each entry's `address` is shown)

setting.description: this module's list setting, one entry per agent: [{ agent: <key>, … }]; the card shows a row's state from it

secret_map.description: kind app: this module's named-secret map, keyed by agent key, whose stored keys say which agents' tokens are in
